lines.text: He admired the living over the dead, but said better than both is he who has not yet existed.

wrong_details.wrong: admired the living over the dead
wrong_details.true: admired the dead above the living

problems.problem: Its wrong detail "has not seen death" isn't found anywhere in the Bible.
Its true detail "has not seen the evil that is done under the sun" isn't in the Prep cards, so the walkthrough didn't teach it.
